'''Rex Shaxrigge''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[holostar]] during the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. While on [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]], a [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] official tried to arrest him for stealing industry secrets; Shaxrigge had allegedly been romancing female executives in order to do so. In response, he pulled a [[Vibro-shiv/Legends|vibro-shiv]] on the officer, but was distracted by a bystander named [[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla|Fiolla]]. Shaxrigge was arrested and the incident led to the start of Fiolla's career with the Authority.
